newsitem.title: USA: United Dominion CFO backs '97 EPS forecast.
newsitem.headline: United Dominion CFO backs '97 EPS forecast.

text.p: The chief financial officer of United Dominion Industries Ltd said he is "comfortable" with Wall Street analysts' consensus earnings per share forecast of $2.20 to $2.30 for 1997.
"We are comfortable with that range," the executive, Glenn Eisenberg, said in an interview after he spoke to the Atlanta Society of Financial Analysts.
He also backed analysts' estimates for the fourth quarter of 1996 of $0.60 to $0.66 per share. He said that 1996 results would be announced on February 14.
Eisenberg said he was "confident" that the supplier of equipment to the construction engineering and steel fabrication markets would reach earnings per share of $3.10 in 1999.
The $3.10 figure was a goal set by the Charlotte, N.C.-based company in 1994.
"We're very confident" in reaching that goal, he said.
